content: The WikiDoc scholar program provides a system for authors to monitor the changes they have made. Authors can track their activity and, if necessary, reference their contributions. Below are the portals that facilitate this process: 1. Total Edit Count: Authors can check the total number of edits they have made by accessing the designated link. A visual guide is provided below to assist with this process. 2. Active Users List: This list displays the activity of users within the past 30 days. To view this list, authors can click on the provided link. 3. Recently Edited Pages: Authors can access a list of pages that have been recently edited. This list can be viewed by clicking on the corresponding link.
